tools/list tools.description:
The desk: what waits on it. Runs one of its read-only commands, named in `command`, with `args` as its usage shows; it changes nothing. Use it:
- `desk list`: Lists what waits on the desk; use it to see what to do next. Usage: `desk list [--all]`

args.description: its arguments after its name, as its usage shows; none by default

command.description: the command to run, as the tool's description names it

page.description: the page of an answer longer than 45000 bytes, which says how many it has; 1 by default

tools/list tools.name: desk
tools/list tools.title: app desk

tools/list tools.description:
app's start greeting, live from its core: what is due and what is queued. Use it at the start of a session, and whenever you ask what to do next. It reads:
- `desk/due`: How many items are due.
- `desk list`: Lists what waits on the desk; use it to see what to do next.

page.description: the page of an answer longer than 45000 bytes, which says how many it has; 1 by default

tools/list tools.name: greeting
tools/list tools.title: app greeting

tools/list tools.description: Whether app's core runs in this checkout, and its health: pid, bus, the sessions holding a lease, the instances and the placed processes. Use it when another tool of this server answers "starting" or fails, or to see what the core carries; it never starts anything the door has not.
